svg.title: Diagnosis follows physical evidence before retuning

svg.text: Diagnosis follows physical evidence before retuning
Valve stem feedback exposes stiction; the independent flow reference exposes sensor drift.
Stiction fingerprint: demand moves while stem holds (%)
Sensor drift: measured PV (red), reference (green dashed) (% flow)
